title: Performance Journey Map: compact per-model & per-route telemetry canvas
creator: Aisha Raman
description: Design a compact "performance journey map" canvas for Redwood Console that surfaces per-model and per-route telemetry (latency percentiles, throughput, tokens per request, token cost breakdown) with fast drill paths into traces and cost analysis. The goal is a single, embeddable panel used on Model Overview and Route Detail pages that balances density with readability and supports canary/rollout overlays.
acceptance_criteria: Canvas presents p50/p95/p99 latency, requests/sec, avg tokens/request and token-cost waterfall in a single view at default 1h/24h/7d ranges
All charts support hover tooltips, aligned crosshair, and time-range brushing that links to microtrace detail and the route activity log
Canary/rollout overlay mode shows baseline vs candidate series with percent-delta badges and a toggle to pin comparisons
Compact layout fits within a 920x280 tile and a larger expanded modal (1280x640) with additional breakdowns
Design handoff includes explicit chart-specs (aggregation, bucket duration, axis types, color tokens) and example queries for instrumentation/metrics team
Prototype validated in 3 quick tests with engineering and a PM; feedback loop captured and next steps listed
design_notes: Prioritize latency percentiles (p50/p95/p99) and tokenized metrics because these map directly to SLOs and cost
Use stacked waterfall for token cost to show prompt vs generation vs embed overhead — keeps cost attribution visible
Provide a lightweight anomaly indicator strip above charts (sparkline band with color-coded anomalies) for fast scanning
Default time-range quick toggles: 1h, 6h, 24h, 7d; allow custom range with linked deep link to Console traces filtered to the model/route
Accessibility: ensure color choices meet contrast, and charts have textual summaries for screen readers (auto-generated by backend summaries)
Mobile: hide minor microtrace swimlanes; keep a single sparkline + delta badge for small widths
chart_specs: Latency ribbon: area chart with three overlaid percentile lines (p50 solid, p95 dashed, p99 dotted). Data points: ms. Aggregation: summary of per-request latencies, bucket duration = 1m for ranges <=24h, 5m for >24h. Y-axis linear, auto-scale, min 0. Color tokens: primary-500 for p50, warning-500 for p95, danger-500 for p99.

Throughput timeline: stacked bar/line hybrid showing requests/sec and concurrent inflight requests. Aggregation: count per bucket; bucket duration = 1m (<=24h) / 5m (>24h). Secondary Y-axis for inflight. Tooltip includes sample rate and percent dropped.

Token-rate heatline (tokens/sec): heatmap row aligned to main timeline. Aggregation: sum tokens generated per bucket. Color gradient low->high mapped to neutral->accent. Click opens token distribution breakdown.

Token-cost waterfall: stacked vertical waterfall for average cost per request with segments [prompt, generation, embeddings, rounding]. Aggregation: mean cost per request over selected window. Show currency unit and cost-per-1000-requests inline.

Request-size violin: violin plot showing distribution of tokens/request with median marker and interquartile box. Useful for understanding tail-cost drivers. Show sample count and bucket percentiles in tooltip.

Canary overlay: render candidate series as semi-transparent dashed lines with delta pill showing % change vs baseline for primary metrics. Include automatic significance hint when delta > 10% for p95 latency or cost per request.
Anomaly index strip: 1-row sparkline using Z-score anomaly detection from infra; color-code per-bucket anomalies and include count in hover.

Drill widgets: each chart has a contextual 'Open traces' action that includes prefilled filters (model_id, route_id, time range, variant tag) and a 'Create issue' quick link pre-filled with selected chart snapshot and metric values.
Default sampling: show raw counts when <=50k events in range, otherwise show sampled histograms with sampling rate annotated in tooltip.
Export: PNG snapshot + JSON payload of visible series for diagnostics and attach-to-PR flow
interaction_patterns: Hover crosshair: unified across all charts when mouseover the canvas. Tooltip aggregates all chart values at that timestamp with relative deltas and links to sample traces
Brush to zoom: click-and-drag on timeline to narrow the global time-range. Brush persists across the embedded panel and model/route list view when 'pin range' is enabled
Compare mode: enable two-up comparison where left = baseline, right = candidate; sync time and allow swapping baselines. Persists as a temporary session until user clears
Pin metric: user can pin any metric (eg p95 latency) to the top summary row for quick reference across pages
Quick actions: top-right kebab provides Export snapshot, Open in full Dashboard, Create Incident, and Link to Rollout (if a rollout is active)
Keyboard shortcuts: 'g' toggles compare mode, 't' toggles time-range presets, '?' opens short help overlay
Progressive disclosure: secondary charts (violin, waterfall details) hidden under 'Expand details' to reduce noise in compact embed
